name: code-writer-agent
body: An implementer agent generated by the agent-builder (the core `implementer` plus each per-subsystem `<name>-implementer`) that turns plan tasks into committed code inside a project worktree. Its tasks include `deletes`, `renames`, and `moves` verbs, whose targets it must actually delete, move, or copy on disk — and it must be able to do so without being handed a blanket filesystem capability. Its interest is a filesystem-operation grant scoped to exactly the surface it owns, so it can implement those tasks while a path outside its owned surface is refused.
